content.title: RAF 7 results: Arman Tsarukyan crushes Georgio Poullas in wild rematch; Colby Covington destroys Dillon Danis
content.text: Arman Tsarukyan continues to rack up wins away from the UFC. The top lightweight contender laid his side-quest rivalry with Georgio Poullas to rest on Saturday night, earning an impressive victory in their much-anticipated wrestling rematch at RAF 7 inside the Yuengling Center in Tampa, Florida.Tsarukyan, 29 and Poullas, 27, went viral in February for their heated match at RAF 6, which devolved into chaos after Tsarukyan nailed Poullas with illegal punches after the final bell and ignited a team-wide brawl. Tsarukyan won that first match by a 5-3 score, then bettered his own mark on Saturday night, picking up a second victory — 9-3 — after a tense and fiery back-and-forth over the three periods.AdvertisementTsarukyan pulled ahead early in RAF 7's rematch, picking up one point in each of the first two periods after Poullas failed to score during multiple shot-clock sequences. The action then picked massively in the match's wild final sprint, with Poullas clawing back into contention by scoring a takedown, only for Tsarukyan to then land a huge four-point throw in the closing seconds to seal his victory.Saturday's result marked the fourth time Tsarukyan has competed outside of the UFC in 2026. The well-traveled lightweight also defeated Lance Palmer in January under the Real American Freestyle banner, then bested former UFC flyweight Muhammad Mokaev in a grappling match earlier this month in Brazil."It was so important [to win this match]," a victorious Tsarukyan said after RAF 7.Advertisement"I'll be RAF champion, UFC champion, and I'll collect all the belts in the world."In the night's co-main event, three-time UFC title challenger Colby Covington destroyed Bellator veteran and current Misfits MMA champion Dillon Danis to win via tech fall, 14-4.After Danis worked his way to a surprising 4-4 tie in the opening period, Covington dialed up his aggression and rattled off a huge 10-0 run in the second stanza to ultimately advance his RAF record to 2-0.Also on the card, RAF champions Kyle Dake, Kyle Snyder, Kennedy Blades and Wyatt Hendrickson all successfully defended their belts.AdvertisementCheck out complete RAF 7 results below, as well as Uncrowned's round-by-round coverage of the evening's final six matches.Main cardMiddleweight: Arman Tsarukyan def.
